text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Ines Fujin engaged in some lively conversation with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep, I recommend starting off with sales or catering! This magazine here lists a bunch of open positions…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wow, there are so many! Are there any that catch your eye, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm. They all look rather inviting, but it's a little difficult to envision what the role entails from the description alone…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Howdy, howdy! These two were asking me for advice on part-time jobs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I figured a part-time job would make for some sweet work experience! That's why I was asking Ines what kind of jobs are out there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So, getting back on topic, I recommend a position at a convenience shop or as a delivery driver—a lotta-lot of those places are eager to hire Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That makes sense—plus you could get a sweet workout carrying stuff around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see… So, what exactly would this job involve, then?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You put on a mascot costume for that one. And you get to play with kids! I had so much fun doing that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And that's not the only fun experience I've had. I helped out with a magic show once, and did some live picture book readings, too. So many memories!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What else… Oh, there was that one time I helped excavate some ruins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ruins?! Wait, do part-time jobs like that actually exist?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Only if you know where to look—they don't usually advertise in magazines like these! Oh, another job you can get is selling lunch boxes at a baseball stadium—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A b-baseball stadium?! They have part-time jobs at baseball stadiums?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Man, this is wild. …I mean, it's pretty amazing that there are so many different job openings crammed into this one magazine, sure…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But what's really remarkable is that you seem to have tried almost all of them, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well, when it comes to part-time jobs, I've gotcha covered! Anyway… Hm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin turns her gaze to a passing Umamusume who's glancing off to the side while carrying a tray piled high with desserts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as the peril of the situation is beginning to dawn on me, her foot slips, and—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone winces, anticipating the inevitable mess of ruined pastries on the ground. …However.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swoosh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Phew. Good thing I caught all those desserts!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: When you're holding a tray, try stabilizing it with your fingers instead of your palms! Oh, and try not to get distracted!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you so much… I'm so sorry about this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How did you do that?! You went whoosh through the air and caught every single dessert!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'd done that before at a part-time gig!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That doesn't explain anything!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Well, I wasn't working as a ninja or anything—it's just a hack I picked up from a diner job.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin laughs off her incredible feat, but it looks like her long work history is paying off in various ways.
choice_data_list: It's like there's nothing you can't do.
It's like there's nothing you can't do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin laughs off her incredible feat, but it looks like her long work history is paying off in various ways.
choice_data_list: It's like there's nothing you can't do.
It's like there's nothing you can't do.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I guess. ♪ But I'm just getting started. I mean, there are still so many professions out there for me to try!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: There are tuna shoal experts, people who research soil to make the best rice, artists who can make stunning pictures using just a few colored pencils…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Seeing pros like those makes me realize there's a lot I can't do! It's a big world out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …I don't know whether you're really overambitious or I'm just massively lacking in work experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I believe we've somehow transitioned from part-time work to full-fledged vocations…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I suspect her scope is a little overblown, I'm reminded of just how talented Ines Fujin really is.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks for the compliment! You know, I do all this because I want to, so it's kinda weird hearing you say that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But now I really want to focus on striking a good balance between my training and my work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …Hmm. I wonder if all that part-time work is the secret to Ines's strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This all goes to show just how beneficial part-time jobs are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like these two are missing the point a little…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer! I'm counting on you to keep supporting me! ♪ I mean, I do rely on you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I come away from the experience feeling like Ines Fujin and I really do have a strong bond.
